what_worked: Correctly identified near-zero traffic-revenue correlation and used median vs. mean to illustrate power-law skew.
fix_next: Synthesis slide (p8) offers generic startup advice unsupported by data; replace platitudes with findings on providers, TLDs, B2B vs B2C revenue, or category medians.
verdict: Thin analysis padded with consulting truisms; few data-driven insights beyond surface counts.
factual_error_detail: Slide 4: 'Top 3 = 31.5%' uses 1,000 as denominator but only 726 rows have categories, so the share among categorized companies is ~43.4% and among all 1,000 it conflates missing with non-membership. Slide 7: Audience-type percentages (56.32/35.81/7.87) sum to ~100% but ignore 288 rows with missing audience_type; denominator should be 712, not 1,000, or missingness should be disclosed.

evidence.insight: Only three quantitative findings presented (category counts, r=0.004, MRR mean/median). No analysis of revenue by category, provider, TLD, B2B vs B2C revenue, anonymity premium, or top-10 concentration. Slide 8 'six principles' are textbook startup advice with no data backing.
evidence.narrative: Four-question framework (slide 2) provides structure, but Q4 ('Success Characteristics') is answered with generic platitudes on slide 8 rather than data. Takeaways (slide 9) mostly restate earlier slides.
evidence.framing: No mention of missingness (241 country, 288 audience_type, 274 category, 286 domain). No limitations section. '29 metrics' claimed but never enumerated or interrogated. Audience for the presentation is never specified.
evidence.accuracy: Traffic-revenue r=0.004 is plausible but unverifiable against reference (reference gives founded-year r=0.025; traffic correlation not in reference so cannot confirm or deny). MRR figures ($13.47M total, $13,472 mean, $282 median) are not directly verifiable against 30-day revenue reference but are internally consistent. Audience-type and country denominators ignore missingness.
evidence.visual: Gamma template produces uniform dark slides with magenta accents. Only two actual charts across 9 slides (bar chart slide 4, donut+bar slide 7). Slide 5 has no scatter plot despite discussing correlation. Slide 6 is big-number cards with no distribution chart. Heavy text density throughout.
evidence.ai_slop: Slide 8 is pure consulting-speak ('Solve a Real Problem,' 'Deliver Clear Value,' 'Retain Customers') with no data evidence. Slide 9 repeats slide content nearly verbatim. Gamma template branding on every slide. Uniform pink-box formatting across all slides.
